verses.en: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
verses.pt: Salva-me, ó Deus, pois as águas me sobem até o pescoço.
verses.en_web: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to Shoshannim. Of David.> Be my saviour, O God; because the waters have come in, even to my neck.

verses.en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.pt: Atolei-me em profundo lamaçal, onde não se pode firmar o pé; entrei na profundeza das águas, onde a corrente me submerge.
verses.en_web: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.en_bbe: My feet are deep in the soft earth, where there is no support; I have come into deep waters, the waves are flowing over me.

verses.en: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.pt: Estou cansado de clamar; secou-se-me a garganta; os meus olhos desfalecem de esperar por meu Deus.
verses.en_web: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
verses.en_bbe: I am tired with my crying; my throat is burning: my eyes are wasted with waiting for my God.

verses.en: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
verses.pt: Aqueles que me odeiam sem causa são mais do que os cabelos da minha cabeça; poderosos são aqueles que procuram destruir-me, que me atacam com mentiras; por isso tenho de restituir o que não extorqui.
verses.en_web: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.
verses.en_bbe: Those who have hate for me without cause are greater in number than the hairs of my head; those who are against me, falsely desiring my destruction, are very strong; I gave back what I had not taken away.

verses.en: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
verses.pt: Tu, ó Deus, bem conheces a minha estultícia, e as minhas culpas não são ocultas.
verses.en_web: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
verses.en_bbe: O God, you see how foolish I am; and my wrongdoing is clear to you.

verses.en: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
verses.pt: Não sejam envergonhados por minha causa aqueles que esperam em ti, ó Senhor Deus dos exércitos; não sejam confundidos por minha causa aqueles que te buscam, ó Deus de Israel.
verses.en_web: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Let not those who have hope in you be put to shame because of me, O Lord God of armies: let not those who are waiting for you be made low because of me, O God of Israel.

verses.en: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
verses.pt: Porque por amor de ti tenho suportado afrontas; a confusão me cobriu o rosto.
verses.en_web: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
verses.en_bbe: I have been wounded with sharp words because of you; my face has been covered with shame.

verses.en: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.
verses.pt: Tornei-me como um estranho para os meus irmãos, e um desconhecido para os filhos de minha mãe.
verses.en_web: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
verses.en_bbe: I have become strange to my brothers, and like a man from a far country to my mother's children.

verses.en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
verses.pt: Pois o zelo da tua casa me devorou, e as afrontas dos que te afrontam caíram sobre mim.
verses.en_web: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
verses.en_bbe: I am on fire with passion for your house; and the hard things which are said about you have come on me.

verses.en: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
verses.pt: Quando chorei e castiguei com jejum a minha alma, isto se me tornou em afrontas.
verses.en_web: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
verses.en_bbe: My bitter weeping, and my going without food, were turned to my shame.

verses.en: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.pt: Quando me vesti de cilício, fiz-me para eles um provérbio.
verses.en_web: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
verses.en_bbe: When I put on the clothing of grief, they said evil of me.

verses.en: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
verses.pt: Aqueles que se sentem à porta falam de mim; e sou objeto das cantigas dos bêbedos.
verses.en_web: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
verses.en_bbe: I am a cause of wonder to those in authority; a song to those who are given to strong drink.

verses.en: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
verses.pt: Eu, porém, faço a minha oração a ti, ó Senhor, em tempo aceitável; ouve-me, ó Deus, segundo a grandeza da tua benignidade, segundo a fidelidade da tua salvação.
verses.en_web: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
verses.en_bbe: But as for me, let my prayer be made to you, O Lord, at a time when you are pleased; O God, give me an answer in your great mercy, for your salvation is certain.

verses.en: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.pt: Tira-me do lamaçal, e não me deixes afundar; seja eu salvo dos meus inimigos, e das profundezas das águas.
verses.en_web: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.en_bbe: Take me from the grip of the sticky earth, so that I may not go down into it; let me be lifted up from the deep waters.

verses.en: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.pt: Não me submerja a corrente das águas e não me trague o abismo, nem cerre a cova a sua boca sobre mim.
verses.en_web: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
verses.en_bbe: Let me not be covered by the flowing waters; let not the deep waters go over my head, and let me not be shut up in the underworld.

verses.en: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
verses.pt: Ouve-me, Senhor, pois grande é a tua benignidade; volta-te para mim segundo a tua muitíssima compaixão.
verses.en_web: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
verses.en_bbe: Give an answer to my words, O Lord; for your mercy is good: be turned to me, because of your great pity.

verses.en: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
verses.pt: Não escondas o teu rosto do teu servo; ouve-me depressa, pois estou angustiado.
verses.en_web: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
verses.en_bbe: Let not your face be covered from your servant, for I am in trouble; quickly give me an answer.

verses.en: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
verses.pt: Aproxima-te da minha alma, e redime-a; resgata-me por causa dos meus inimigos.
verses.en_web: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
verses.en_bbe: Come near to my soul, for its salvation: be my saviour, because of those who are against me.

verses.en: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
verses.pt: Tu conheces o meu opróbrio, a minha vergonha, e a minha ignomínia; diante de ti estão todos os meus adversários.
verses.en_web: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
verses.en_bbe: You have seen my shame, how I was laughed at and made low; my haters are all before you.

verses.en: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.pt: Afrontas quebrantaram-me o coração, e estou debilitado. Esperei por alguém que tivesse compaixão, mas não houve nenhum; e por consoladores, mas não os achei.
verses.en_web: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
verses.en_bbe: My heart is broken by bitter words, I am full of grief; I made a search for some to have pity on me, but there was no one; I had no comforter.

verses.en: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.pt: Deram-me fel por mantimento, e na minha sede me deram a beber vinagre.
verses.en_web: They also gave me gall for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.en_bbe: They gave me poison for my food; and bitter wine for my drink.

verses.en: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
verses.pt: Torne-se a sua mesa diante deles em laço, e sejam-lhes as suas ofertas pacíficas uma armadilha.
verses.en_web: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
verses.en_bbe: Let their table before them be for their destruction; let their feasts become a net to take them.

verses.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.pt: Obscureçam-se-lhes os olhos, para que não vejam, e faze com que os seus lombos tremam constantemente.
verses.en_web: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
verses.en_bbe: Let their eyes be blind so that they may not see; let their bodies for ever be shaking.

verses.en: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.pt: Derrama sobre eles a tua indignação, e apanhe-os o ardor da tua ira.
verses.en_web: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
verses.en_bbe: Let your curse come on them; let the heat of your wrath overtake them.

verses.en: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
verses.pt: Fique desolada a sua habitação, e não haja quem habite nas suas tendas.
verses.en_web: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
verses.en_bbe: Give their houses to destruction, and let there be no one in their tents.

verses.en: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
verses.pt: Pois perseguem a quem afligiste, e aumentam a dor daqueles a quem feriste.
verses.en_web: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
verses.en_bbe: Because they are cruel to him against whom your hand is turned; they make bitter the grief of him who is wounded by you.

verses.en: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
verses.pt: Acrescenta iniqüidade à iniqüidade deles, e não encontrem eles absolvição na tua justiça.
verses.en_web: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: Let their punishment be increased; let them not come into your righteousness.

verses.en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.pt: Sejam riscados do livro da vida, e não sejam inscritos com os justos.
verses.en_web: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: Let their names be taken from the book of the living, let them not be numbered with the upright.

verses.en: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
verses.pt: Eu, porém, estou aflito e triste; a tua salvação, ó Deus, me ponha num alto retiro.
verses.en_web: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
verses.en_bbe: But I am poor and full of sorrow; let me be lifted up by your salvation, O Lord.

verses.en: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.pt: Louvarei o nome de Deus com um cântico, e engrandecê-lo-ei com ação de graças.
verses.en_web: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.en_bbe: I will give praise to the name of God with a song; I will give glory to him for what he has done.

verses.en: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
verses.pt: Isto será mais agradável ao Senhor do que um boi, ou um novilho que tem pontas e unhas.
verses.en_web: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
verses.en_bbe: This will be more pleasing to the Lord than an ox, or a young ox of full growth.

verses.en: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
verses.pt: Vejam isto os mansos, e se alegrem; vós que buscais a Deus reviva o vosso coração.
verses.en_web: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
verses.en_bbe: The poor will see it and be glad: you who are lovers of God, let your hearts have life.

verses.en: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor ouve os necessitados, e não despreza os seus, embora sejam prisioneiros.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
verses.en_bbe: For the ears of the Lord are open to the poor, and he takes thought for his prisoners.

verses.en: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
verses.pt: Louvem-no os céus e a terra, os mares e tudo quanto neles se move.
verses.en_web: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
verses.en_bbe: Let the heavens and the earth give praise to him, the seas, and everything moving in them.

verses.en: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.pt: Porque Deus salvará a Sião, e edificará as cidades de Judá, e ali habitarão os seus servos e a possuirão.
verses.en_web: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
verses.en_bbe: For God will be the saviour of Zion, and the builder of the towns of Judah; so that it may be their resting-place and heritage.

verses.en: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.pt: E herdá-la-á a descendência de seus servos, e os que amam o seu nome habitarão nela.
verses.en_web: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.en_bbe: The seed of his servants will have their part in it, and there the lovers of his name will have rest.
